subject: AI pre-meal advisor: "I'm thinking about…"
description: Before eating, tell the AI what you're considering (e.g. 'Chipotle bowl', 'frozen pizza', 'Wendy's on the road') and get a contextual verdict. Build on the daily check-in plumbing (BuildDailyPromptAsync context: today's meals/drinks so far, sleep, workout, day type, 7-day meal names, coaching goals, today's notes) plus the considered item. Output: verdict (good / fine / reconsider) with one-line reasoning grounded in today ('light on protein so far', 'sodium already high'), and TWO alternatives — one restaurant/fast-food-style and one homemade — under the existing rules (judge the food not the venue, respect user goals, no zero-pushing, zero-sugar drinks fine). UI: '🤔 Thinking about…' input + Ask button on the Meals page near the log form; a 'Going with it' button pre-fills the meal form with the chosen option so advice flows into the log. One Gemini call per ask, on demand.
